description: Versioned settings for the primary controlled experiment (updated RAGU configuration; not a reproduction of RAGU's legacy gpt-4o-mini setup). A null value means the parameter is NOT sent to the API and the provider default applies.

llm.notes: Run 1/2/Q1 were executed with no temperature, reasoning_effort, max token or seed parameter sent, so these nulls describe how those results were produced. LLM output is not guaranteed reproducible without a seed; entity/edge counts differed between Run 1 and Run 2.

ragu.notes: third_party/ is git-ignored, so this pin is the record of the exact RAGU version. Project Python is newer than RAGU's declared classifiers; Windows install compatibility is unverified.
